#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class Reader {
public:
    static void init() {
        // No initialization needed for cin
    }

    static string next() {
        string token;
        cin >> token;
        return token;
    }

    static int nextInt() {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        return x;
    }

    static long long nextLong() {
        long long x;
        cin >> x;
        return x;
    }

    static double nextDouble() {
        double x;
        cin >> x;
        return x;
    }

    static string nextLine() {
        string str;
        getline(cin, str);
        return str;
    }
};

long long ones[] = {0, 1, 11, 111, 1111, 11111, 111111, 1111111, 11111111, 111111111, 1111111111, 11111111111LL, 111111111111LL, 1111111111111LL, 11111111111111LL, 111111111111111LL, 1111111111111111LL};

long long getNumOfDigits(long long n) {
    return (long long) floor(log10(n)) + 1;
}

long long decompose(long long n) {
    if (n <= 6) {
        return n;
    }
    long long numOfDigits = getNumOfDigits(n);
    long long lower, upper;
    lower = ones[numOfDigits];
    if (n < lower) {
        upper = lower;
        lower = ones[numOfDigits - 1];
    } else if (n > lower) {
        upper = ones[numOfDigits + 1];
    } else {
        return numOfDigits;
    }
    long long resLower = decompose(n % lower) + (n / lower) * getNumOfDigits(lower);
    long long resUpper = LLONG_MAX;
    if (upper - n < n) {
        resUpper = decompose(upper - n) + getNumOfDigits(upper);
    }
    return min(resLower, resUpper);
}

int main() {
    Reader::init();
    long long n = Reader::nextLong();
    long long res = decompose(n);
    cout << res << endl;
    return 0;
}
